notes.title: Major Game Update for Last Line VR!
notes.content:
Hi folks! Our lastest game update is live now!

Huge optimization improvements! Performance increased about %100

Clean and relax play sessions, many bugs fixed.

General game balance improved. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35190760/b000f82a859ec6a69a15411714b2cdda7c0d02f9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Space Update is out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35190760/e9402366cde690733a423e6262afbb3238df2bf2.png[/img]

Hi folks,

Finally new update is ready! 

[h1]Space Update features[/h1][list]
[*]New Map: Endless-Mode
[*]New Map: Mini-Story in space cruiser
[*]New alien enemy type
[*]New defense system: Anti-Golem defense system
[*]New defense system: Garrison Soldiers
[*]New defense system: Clean-Bots
[*]New defense system: Rocket defense system
[*]New space weapons
[/list]

[h1]Game[/h1][list]
[*]Increasing performance and stabilization on frame rates per second
[*]Weapon magazine collision bug fixed
[*]Endless-mode zombie counts balanced
[*]Camera height bug fixed
[*]Weapon locked bug fixed
[*]Horde spawn performance problems fixed
[*]Maximum zombie number increased in Endless-Mode
[*]Home-Defense additions
[*]And more!
[/list]

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: We're going to Spaceee!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35190760/f19ac17f8cc7eba7f46023c49418e8daec735c3b.png[/img]

Hi folks! 

We have 2 announcement for you.

First of all, thank you for being a part of Astro Quality Games. This game is our first step to the ground.

Today we released Last Line VR's 1.1v patch. We are very pleased with the current version of the game.

[b]|Our first news[/b] is LL|VR will get another patch which is necessary for challenge soul of game. We want players to have fun with their survival efforts. 
[h1]-RELEASED, OUT NOW!-[/h1]
Coming [strike]31 July[/strike] with lots of change and bug fixes. 


[b]|And the second one;[/b] We will offer you a free DLC. One of our survivor is going to space! A hundred years after the epidemic.
[list]
[*]New environments
[*]New weapons
[*]New defense systems
[*]New enemy types
[/list]
Coming very soon!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35190760/8a3ac75761b430f2f53502398a0ce698f107ad14.png[/img]

notes.title: New Update 1.1! Out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35190760/5e5f346dabd389c9190d43fd9a8dc38da37043fd.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Hi everyone![/b][/h1]
      In line with your comments and feedbacks about LL|VR, we have prepared a patch to make the game better. You can share your opinions and suggestions about the game from our discord channel and discussion section. In some comments the difficulty of the game was mentioned. We believe that the game is challenging, which increases the sense of survival. We like to challenge players with this approach that forces them to use the mechanics of the game.

[h1]New Features and Balance Settings of Game[/h1]
[list]
[*]New detailed tutorial map.
[*]Zombie wave balance in story mode.
[*]Turret and mine price balance
[*]Decrease the percentage of deceleration when the character receives damage from the zombies.
[*]Added '$' symbol to points.
[*]Player HP is now x2.
[*]In Home-Defense mode we add Tesla Turret and Mines.
[*]Balanced maximum zombie size on Endless and Home-Defense modes.
[*]New sound effects for buying gun or turrets.
[*]Balanced Turret HP's
[*]Balanced Magazine prices
[*]And some minor additions
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Sniper Rifle optics
[*]Some issues of grab 2 weapon is fixed
[*]Constant move speed fixed
[*]Some weapon sizes was wrong
[*]Vibration bug at last bullet
[*]Colors of Boxes (enable/disable colors)
[*]Fixed Pause Menu Buttons render range
[*]Valve Index Run button click (can't test)
[*]Player Height is lower than before
[*]Lighting on Farm Night Map
[*]Pause menu movement locked
[*]And some minor bugs
[*]Home-Defense Repair Buttons
[*]Home-Defense Point saves
[/list]

Discord: https://discord.gg/7trcr2r

Thank you for having us! Please let us know your opinions.
